name: Gaza Ministry of Health
affiliation: Health authority in Gaza's civil administration, which Hamas has governed since 2007
notes: UN agencies have treated its totals as reliable; a senior IDF official said in Jan 2026 the overall toll is largely accurate. Does not distinguish civilians from combatants.

name: Tech for Palestine datasets
notes: Republishes Gaza MoH lists and daily reports as an open API.

name: COGAT
affiliation: Unit of the Israeli Ministry of Defense coordinating civilian matters in Gaza and the West Bank
notes: Counts all cargo it clears, including private-sector goods.

name: Israel Defense Forces
notes: Figures on combatants killed are not published with names or a method.

name: UN2720 Mechanism (UNOPS)
affiliation: United Nations, mandated by Security Council resolution 2720
notes: Tracks only UN-manifested consignments, not all aid.

name: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification
affiliation: Joint initiative of UN agencies, NGOs and governments

name: Jamaluddine et al., The Lancet (2025)
affiliation: LSHTM, Yale and others; no funding declared

name: Gaza Mortality Survey
affiliation: Spagat et al. with the Palestinian Center for Policy and Survey Research; Lancet Global Health (2026)

name: UNOSAT (UN Satellite Centre)
affiliation: Satellite analysis centre of UNITAR, the UN training and research institute
notes: Counts damaged structures from satellite images, compared with images from before the war. Its Gaza assessments are marked preliminary and not validated on the ground.

name: Gaza Government Media Office
affiliation: Media office of Gaza's civil administration, which Hamas has governed since 2007
notes: Publishes running totals of destroyed and damaged buildings. It does not publish a method, and Tech for Palestine, which republishes them, advises treating them as estimates.
